process_area.title: DG Storage/Handling Safety, Incident Response & Regulatory Compliance

value_stream.name: Dangerous Goods (DG) & Hazardous Materials Transport, Ecommerce & Regulatory Compliance

fields.Participants: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer, HSE (links to VS-24.3), Facilities (links to VS-20.3/VS-07.2), DC Operations (links to VS-04), Store Operations (links to VS-07), BFP/Fire Safety, Quality (links to VS-31)
fields.Trigger: DG storage design/change (DC, store); inspection cycle; incident
fields.Volume: 200 stores + 4 DCs with DG storage areas (paint/chemical cages)

workflows.name: DG Storage Compliance & Fixed-Site Risk Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "monitoring, and reconciliation to the hazmat inventory" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-inspect of "inspect DG storage compliance on a schedule" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-573 (ensure controlled execution — DG Storage/Handling Safety, Incident Response & Regulatory Compliance (PA-114.3).)
- operational: standards and inspection; operational: quantity monitoring
Pain Points / Risks: - **Storage-non-compliance risk**: Improper segregation/containment causes fire/spill; mitigated by standards and inspection
- **Quantity-excess risk**: Storing beyond permit/area limits breaches Fire Code; mitigated by quantity monitoring
System Touchpoints: - HSE/DC/store facility (links to VS-24.3/VS-04/VS-07/VS-20.3); hazmat inventory (links to W3595); permits (links to W3614); findings/analytics (links to W3616)

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/HSE define DG fixed-site storage compliance standards (in partnership with VS-24.3): segregated storage (incompatible separation), ventilation, spill containment, fire suppression (links to VS-24.3 BFP), temperature control, quantity limits per area, signage, and emergency equipment (eyewash, spill kit); align to DENR ECC and BFP Fire Code

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/HSE/Facilities implement and maintain DG storage compliance across DCs and stores: storage layout, ventilation/suppression integrity, signage/equipment, quantity monitoring, and reconciliation to the hazmat inventory (W3595); resolve deficiencies

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/HSE inspect DG storage compliance on a schedule (DC monthly, store quarterly per VS-24.3 cadence), manage findings to closure, and report fixed-site DG compliance and risk to governance (W3616); coordinate the interface with VS-24.3 (worker-safety storage) to avoid duplication

fields.Participants: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer, HSE (links to VS-24), DC Operations (links to VS-04), Store Operations (links to VS-07), Ecommerce (links to VS-10), Logistics (links to VS-06), Occupational Health (links to VS-83), Procurement (links to VS-34)
fields.Trigger: Role/task involving DG handling; PPE cycle; incident
fields.Volume: DG-handling workers across DCs, stores, ecommerce, drivers

workflows.name: DG Handling Procedures, PPE & Worker Safety

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "monitoring/health surveillance for high-exposure roles" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track exposure/incident data" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-573 (ensure controlled execution — DG Storage/Handling Safety, Incident Response & Regulatory Compliance (PA-114.3).)
- operational: PPE, monitoring, and health surveillance; operational: supervision and training
Pain Points / Risks: - **Exposure risk**: Chronic chemical exposure harms workers; mitigated by PPE, monitoring, and health surveillance
- **Procedure-non-compliance risk**: Workers skip PPE/procedures; mitigated by supervision and training
System Touchpoints: - HSE/PPE (links to VS-24); SDS (links to W3595); training (links to W3597); occupational health (links to VS-83); operations (links to VS-04/VS-07/VS-10/VS-06); findings (links to W3616)

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/HSE define DG handling procedures and PPE standards by task (receive, store, pick, pack, ship, display, cut/mix paint, deliver): safe-lift/transfer, decanting/mixing, no-smoking/no-ignition, spill first-response, exposure first-aid (per SDS W3595); specify PPE (gloves, goggles, respirator, apron) by chemical/task

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/HSE/Operations implement handling procedures and PPE: train workers (links to W3597), provision and maintain PPE, post handling instructions and SDS access (links to VS-24.3), supervise compliance, and manage exposure monitoring/health surveillance for high-exposure roles (links to VS-83)
steps.r: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer / HSE / Operations / Occupational Health

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/HSE audit handling/PPE compliance, manage findings, track exposure/incident data (links to W3613), and feed corrective action to procedures/training/PPE; report worker-safety DG posture to governance (W3616) and occupational health (links to VS-83)

fields.Participants: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer, HSE (links to VS-24/VS-26.2), Site Operations, Hazmat Contractor, Occupational Health (links to VS-83), Facilities (links to VS-20.3), Environmental/Sustainability (links to VS-25), DENR-EMB
fields.Trigger: DG spill/leak at a fixed site (DC, store, ecommerce pack station)

Automation Opportunity: - System workflow orchestration of "coordinate with DENR-EMB for environmental release" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/HSE investigate the spill root-cause" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-573 (ensure controlled execution — DG Storage/Handling Safety, Incident Response & Regulatory Compliance (PA-114.3).)
- operational: containment and drain protection; operational: spill plan and hazmat contractor on retainer
Pain Points / Risks: - **Environmental-release risk**: Spill reaching drain/soil causes DENR liability; mitigated by containment and drain protection
- **Slow-clean-up risk**: Delayed clean-up spreads contamination; mitigated by spill plan and hazmat contractor on retainer
System Touchpoints: - SDS/spill kit (links to W3595); HSE/incident (links to VS-24/VS-26.2); hazardous waste (links to W3612); environmental (links to VS-25); records (links to W3613/W3600)

steps.activity: Site staff/HSE respond to the spill: immediate safety (isolate, evacuate if needed, PPE), first response per SDS (W3595) and spill kit, containment (booms/pads/drain cover to prevent environmental release), and notification to DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/HSE; engage hazmat contractor for significant spills
steps.r: Site Staff / HSE / DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/HSE/Hazmat Contractor manage clean-up and remediation: recover/absorb the spilled material, decontaminate the area, manage the waste as hazardous (W3612), restore storage/handling, and conduct environmental assessment if release occurred; coordinate with DENR-EMB for environmental release (links to VS-25)
steps.r: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer / HSE / Hazmat Contractor

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/HSE investigate the spill root-cause (links to VS-24/VS-21), document (W3613/W3600), and implement corrective/preventive action (training W3597, packaging W3598, storage W3609, procedures W3610); report to governance (W3616)

fields.Participants: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer, Sustainability/Environmental (links to VS-25), Waste Mgmt (links to VS-73), HSE (links to VS-24), DENR-EMB-accredited Transporter/Treater, Logistics (links to VS-06), Finance (links to VS-17)
fields.Trigger: DG waste generation (spills W3611, expired/returned DG, contaminated material, empty containers); disposal cycle

workflows.name: DG Hazardous Waste Transport, Disposal & DENR-EMB Manifest

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-record of "DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Sustainability classify and accumulate hazardous waste per" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Sustainability maintain the hazardous-waste register and DENR-EMB" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-573 (ensure controlled execution — DG Storage/Handling Safety, Incident Response & Regulatory Compliance (PA-114.3).)
- operational: accredited transporter/treater and manifest; operational: cradle-to-grave tracking
Pain Points / Risks: - **Improper-disposal risk**: Non-accredited disposal breaches RA 6969 and attracts penalty/liability; mitigated by accredited transporter/treater and manifest
- **Manifest-reconciliation risk**: Manifest gaps fail DENR audit; mitigated by cradle-to-grave tracking
System Touchpoints: - Waste/circular economy (links to VS-73); ESG/sustainability (links to VS-25); HSE (links to VS-24); DENR-EMB manifest; transport compliance (links to W3602/W3603); records (links to VS-88/W3600)

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Sustainability classify and accumulate hazardous waste per DENR-EMB (RA 6969): waste classification (hazardous waste category per DAO 2013-22), accumulation/storage at site (satellite/central, within the 90-day on-site accumulation limit), labeling/marking, and the waste-profile record; manage waste streams (expired DG, spill residue, contaminated packaging, used oils/solvents)
steps.r: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer / Sustainability / Waste Mgmt

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Waste Mgmt arrange hazardous-waste transport and disposal with DENR-EMB-accredited transporter and treater (TSD facility): the DENR-EMB hazardous-waste transport manifest (4-part manifest per RA 6969), transport compliance (W3602/W3603), the treatment/disposal certificate (cradle-to-grave), and the chain-of-custody
steps.r: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer / Waste Mgmt / Transporter

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Sustainability maintain the hazardous-waste register and DENR-EMB reporting (annual hazardous-waste generation/disposal report, registration as generator, manifest reconciliation), align to circular economy/waste-reduction (links to VS-73), and report to governance (W3616) and ESG (links to VS-25.3)

fields.Participants: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer, HSE (links to VS-24), Audit (links to VS-21), Legal (links to VS-100), Compliance (links to VS-22), Risk (links to VS-21.2), Insurance (links to VS-26), Occupational Health (links to VS-83)
fields.Trigger: DG incident (transport W3606, spill W3611, exposure W3610, fire)

workflows.name: DG Incident Investigation, Reporting & Regulatory Notification

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-report of "report with corrective/preventive action" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "track CAPA to closure, capture the incident in the DG incident register and…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-573 (ensure controlled execution — DG Storage/Handling Safety, Incident Response & Regulatory Compliance (PA-114.3).)
- operational: structured RCA; operational: notification protocol and 24/7 duty
Pain Points / Risks: - **Root-cause-miss risk**: Superficial investigation allows recurrence; mitigated by structured RCA
- **Late-notification risk**: Missed regulatory notification timeline attracts penalty; mitigated by notification protocol and 24/7 duty
System Touchpoints: - HSE/incident (links to VS-24); audit (links to VS-21); legal (links to VS-100); compliance (links to VS-22); risk (links to VS-21.2); insurance (links to VS-26); occupational health (links to VS-83); records (links to VS-88/W3600)

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/HSE conduct incident investigation: secure the scene/evidence, interview, root-cause analysis (5-why/fishbone), contributing factors (classification W3594, packaging W3598, handling W3610, carrier W3601, storage W3609), and the investigation report with corrective/preventive action (CAPA)

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Compliance manage regulatory notification and reporting: DENR-EMB (environmental release), DOLE (worker injury/exposure, links to VS-24), BFP (fire), MARINA/Coast Guard/CAB/LTFRB (transport), LGU, and the BSP/insurance (links to VS-26); within statutory timelines; manage regulator follow-up

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/HSE track CAPA to closure, capture the incident in the DG incident register and loss-event database, feed learnings to classification/packaging/training/carrier/storage, and report incident trends and loss events to governance (W3616), risk (links to VS-21.2), and audit (links to VS-21)

fields.Participants: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer, Facilities (links to VS-20.3/VS-07.2), Compliance/Regulatory (links to VS-22), HSE (links to VS-24), BFP Fire Safety Inspector, DENR-EMB, LGU (links to VS-76), Legal (links to VS-100.3)
fields.Trigger: New site/DC/store (links to VS-37/VS-20); permit renewal; storage/process change

workflows.name: DG Site Permitting, Fire Code & BFP Compliance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-inspect of "DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Facilities/Compliance manage DG-related site permits" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-detect of "detection, exits/egress, occupancy limits, and the annual fire safety inspection" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report DG permitting/Fire Code compliance to governance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-573 (ensure controlled execution — DG Storage/Handling Safety, Incident Response & Regulatory Compliance (PA-114.3).)
- operational: renewal calendar; operational: fire-load calculation and suppression adequacy
Pain Points / Risks: - **Permit-lapse risk**: Operating without valid ECC/FSIC attracts closure/penalty; mitigated by renewal calendar
- **Fire-code-breach risk**: Inadequate fire protection for DG load; mitigated by fire-load calculation and suppression adequacy
System Touchpoints: - Permits/compliance (links to VS-22); LGU (links to VS-76); facility (links to VS-20.3/VS-07.2); HSE/fire (links to VS-24.3); records (links to VS-88/W3600)

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Facilities/Compliance manage DG-related site permits: DENR-EMB Environmental Compliance Certificate (ECC) / Permit to Operate (PTO) for hazardous-material storage, BFP Fire Safety Inspection Certificate (FSIC) for flammable storage, LGU permits (links to VS-76), and DOLE OSH compliance; secure for new sites and renew on cycle

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Facilities ensure Fire Code (BFP) compliance for DG storage: fire-load calculation, fire suppression/extinguisher adequacy (links to W3609), alarm/detection, exits/egress, occupancy limits, and the annual fire safety inspection; manage deficiencies

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Compliance maintain the DG permit register and renewal calendar, manage inspections/findings (links to W3600), and report DG permitting/Fire Code compliance to governance (W3616); coordinate multi-site rollouts (200 sites)

fields.Participants: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer, Risk & Insurance (links to VS-26), Legal (links to VS-100), Finance (links to VS-17/VS-18), Logistics (links to VS-06/VS-110), Procurement (links to VS-34), Broker/Insurer
fields.Trigger: Insurance renewal (links to VS-26); DG risk change; incident/claim

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics manage DG risk transfer to carriers/3PLs/vendors" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track DG loss experience and feed to underwriting/renewal and to governance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-573 (ensure controlled execution — DG Storage/Handling Safety, Incident Response & Regulatory Compliance (PA-114.3).)
- operational: exposure modeling and adequate limits; operational: legal-reviewed terms and COI discipline
Pain Points / Risks: - **Under-insurance risk**: DG exposure exceeds coverage limits; mitigated by exposure modeling and adequate limits
- **Untransferred risk**: Carrier/vendor DG liability not contractually allocated; mitigated by legal-reviewed terms and COI discipline
System Touchpoints: - Insurance (links to VS-26.3/W853); legal (links to VS-100); finance (links to VS-17/VS-18); carrier/vendor risk transfer (links to W3601/W3599); claims/recovery (links to VS-90); risk (links to VS-21.2)

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Risk & Insurance define DG insurance and risk-transfer requirements: property (DG storage fire/explosion), marine/cargo (DG transit links to VS-26), public/product liability (DG exposure to customers/public), environmental liability (pollution), and motor (DG carriage); align to the corporate insurance program (links to VS-26.3)

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Risk & Insurance/Logistics manage DG risk transfer to carriers/3PLs/vendors: contractual liability allocation (carrier indemnity W3601, vendor obligation W3599), certificates of insurance from DG carriers/contractors, and subrogation/recovery (links to VS-90); ensure coverage adequacy and limits
steps.r: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer / Risk & Insurance / Legal / Logistics

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/Risk & Insurance manage DG claims (links to VS-26/W853): incident notification, claim filing, adjuster coordination, recovery/subrogation, and settlement; track DG loss experience and feed to underwriting/renewal and to governance (W3616) and risk (links to VS-21.2)
steps.r: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer / Risk & Insurance / Legal

fields.Participants: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer, BI (links to VS-28.1), HSE (links to VS-24), Logistics (links to VS-06/VS-110), Ecommerce (links to VS-10), Audit (links to VS-21), Risk (links to VS-21.2), ExCo (links to VS-33.2), Board/Risk Committee (links to VS-36)

workflows.name: DG Compliance Analytics, Loss-Event Review & Continuous Improvement

Automation Opportunity: - System continuous audit of "audit scores, classification/SDS coverage, training currency, transport/carrier…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "review and trend analysis" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-post of "posture, loss events, risk, and continuous-improvement initiatives to the risk…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-573 (ensure controlled execution — DG Storage/Handling Safety, Incident Response & Regulatory Compliance (PA-114.3).)
- operational: leading indicators (near-miss, findings); operational: governance accountability and tracked CAPA
Pain Points / Risks: - **Reactive-program risk**: Program measures lagging indicators only; mitigated by leading indicators (near-miss, findings)
- **Action-inertia risk**: Analytics not acted on; mitigated by governance accountability and tracked CAPA
System Touchpoints: - BI/dashboards (links to VS-28.1); incident/loss-event register (links to W3613); risk (links to VS-21.2); governance (links to VS-36); audit (links to VS-21); program strategy (links to W3593)

steps.activity: DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer/BI define and instrument DG program metrics: compliance audit scores, classification/SDS coverage, training currency, transport/carrier compliance, ecommerce ship-eligibility coverage, incidents/near-misses/loss events, permit currency, insurance loss ratio, and DG cost (premium, remediation, claims)

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer conduct loss-event review and trend analysis: incident root-cause patterns, recurring carriers/sites/SKUs/categories, leading indicators (near-misses, findings), and emerging risk (regulatory change W3596); produce the DG program dashboard and risk view

DG/Hazmat Compliance Officer report DG posture, loss events, risk, and continuous-improvement initiatives to the risk committee (links to VS-21.2/VS-36) and ExCo (links to VS-33.2), drive corrective/preventive action across classification/packaging/training/transport/storage, and feed learnings to standards (W3598) and program strategy (W3593)
